title: BidderFact
description: Represents an individual verifiable parameter or claim extracted from a bidder's submission.

fact_id.description: Unique identifier for the extracted fact (e.g., FACT-BID001-TURNOVER-01).

bid_id.description: Identifier of the bid this fact belongs to.

bidder_id.description: Identifier of the bidder / submitting company (e.g., company name or entity code).

field.description: Normalized parameter name (e.g., average_annual_turnover, warranty_years, delivery_days, iso_14001_cert, gstin, pan, local_support).

value.description: Raw extracted value (can be numeric, string, boolean, date object, array, or dictionary).

normalized_value.description: Standardized canonical value for deterministic evaluation (e.g. numeric INR, integer count, boolean, uppercase string).

unit.description: Unit associated with the value (e.g., INR, INR_CRORE, YEARS, DAYS, PERCENT, COUNT, BOOLEAN).

source_document.description: Filename or document identifier from which the fact was extracted (e.g., BID-00001.pdf, balance_sheet.pdf).

page.description: 1-indexed page number in the source document where the fact appears.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates of the extracted snippet [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] or [x0, y0, x1, y1].

raw_text_snippet.description: Exact text excerpt surrounding the extracted fact for audit trail.

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence level of the extraction model.

extraction_method.description: Pipeline component or method responsible for extraction.

metadata.description: Additional domain-specific attributes (e.g. issuing CA name, certificate number, expiry date).

evidence.description: Visual and textual proof pointing to all physical source blocks in submitted documents.

block_id.description: Physical block identifier from Step 6 segmentation.

bbox.description: Bounding box coordinates [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax].

snippet.description: Text content excerpt of the physical block.

canonical_field.description: Deterministic canonical ontology field identifier (e.g., ANNUAL_TURNOVER, WARRANTY_DURATION).

field_resolution.description: Traceable resolution metadata from the deterministic canonical field ontology.
